_about: The Historical kit: pieces rebuilt from historical reference images, as detailing meshes for the greybox. Grouped by category (the material: Woodwork, Stonework, Ironwork) and type, which are also the folders: reference images in _builder/images/sheets/historical/<Category>/<Type>/<id>.png (the site shows only these), work files in _Docs/Kit/Historical/<Category>/<Type>/, FBX in _Docs/Kit/FBX/Historical/<Category>/<Type>/. Mesh name SM_HI_<Type>_<Descriptor>_<NN>, image id HI-<Type>_<Descriptor>_<NN>. method: blender-fretwork, blender-lathe, blender-sweep, blender-modelled or meshy.

intro: Sawn and carved brackets under eaves, balconies and jetties.
Gesägte und geschnitzte Konsolen unter Traufen, Balkonen und Vorkragungen.
Turned, twisted and sawn wooden balusters for stairs, galleries and balconies.
Gedrechselte, gedrehte und gesägte Holzbaluster für Treppen, Galerien und Balkone.
Timber posts with their head beams, braces and sills, as they stand under galleries and jetties.
Holzständer mit Sattelholz, Kopfbändern und Schwelle, wie sie unter Galerien und Vorkragungen stehen.
Turned stone balusters for terraces, balconies and stair rails.
Gedrehte Steinbaluster für Terrassen, Balkone und Treppengeländer.
Forged weather vanes for roof points, gables and towers.
Geschmiedete Wetterfahnen für Dachspitzen, Giebel und Türme.
Sheet-iron strap hinges for doors, gates and shutters, each nail hole cut through.
Langbänder aus Flacheisen für Türen, Tore und Läden, jedes Nagelloch durchgehend.
Forged scrollwork from round bar, for doors and walls.
Geschmiedete Ranken aus Rundeisen für Türen und Wände.

name: Fretwork bracket
Laubsägekonsole
pieces.note: Traced from the reference with trace_profile.py and built with build_fretwork.py; a 2.5 cm board with a 3.5 cm upright. Width of 60 cm assumed.

name: Weather vane with monogram
Wetterfahne mit Monogramm
pieces.note: Flag traced (8 mm sheet); rod, stem, collar and sleeves turned from the measured profile; fleur-de-lis finial traced and shaped as a forged height field with a spine. 1 px = 1 mm, so 1.43 m tall. Pivot at the rod's tip.

name: Strap hinge with fan-leaf end
Langband mit Blattfächer
pieces.note: Traced (outline and every nail hole) and built as 6 mm sheet iron with build_ironwork.py --mode flat; 70 cm long assumed. Pivot at the hinge end, centred.

name: Strap hinge with scrolls
Langband mit Voluten
pieces.note: Traced (outline and every nail hole) and built as 6 mm sheet iron with build_ironwork.py --mode flat; 70 cm long assumed. Pivot at the hinge end, centred.

name: Strap hinge with crescent
Langband mit Halbmond
pieces.note: Traced (outline and every nail hole) and built as 6 mm sheet iron with build_ironwork.py --mode flat; 70 cm long assumed. Pivot at the hinge end, centred.

name: Strap hinge with curled tee
Langband mit gerolltem Kreuz
pieces.note: Traced (outline and every nail hole) and built as 6 mm sheet iron with build_ironwork.py --mode flat; 70 cm long assumed. Pivot at the hinge end, centred.

name: Strap hinge with fleur-de-lis
Langband mit Lilie
pieces.note: Traced (outline and every nail hole) and built as 6 mm sheet iron with build_ironwork.py --mode flat; 70 cm long assumed. Pivot at the hinge end, centred.

name: Forged scroll ornament
Geschmiedetes Rankenornament
pieces.note: Traced and built as half-round bar on a flat back with build_ironwork.py --mode forged; 50 cm tall assumed. Pivot at the wall plate.

name: Barley-twist baluster
Baluster mit Kordeldrehung
pieces.note: Turned from the profile measured row by row; rope twist (5 beads), twisted bulb (10), reeded urn (18) and a 12-leaf collar carved onto the turned surface; gilt rings as a second material (M_TW_Brass). 90 cm tall assumed. The band's small gilt ornaments are left out.

name: Stone vase baluster
Steinbaluster in Vasenform
pieces.note: Turned from the profile measured row by row (build_lathe.py), every moulding kept: cove and fillet under the cap, two fillet-and-torus rings, the vase belly, scotia and torus at the foot; square cap, plate and plinth with small bevels. 80 cm tall assumed. The granite speckle is texture.

name: Stone bulb baluster
Steinbaluster mit tiefem Bauch
pieces.note: Turned from the profile measured row by row (build_lathe.py): cushion collar and fillet under the cap, astragal, the long flaring shaft, collar ring, the low bulb, a torus ring, the narrow neck and the flared foot on a round disc; square cap and plinth with small bevels. 90 cm tall assumed. The stone grain is texture.

name: Braced post with rope twist
Ständer mit Kopfbändern und Kordeldrehung
pieces.note: Head beam, two scalloped braces (Kopfbänder) lapped over the beam and onto the post (traced from the photo, the right one mirrored), square upper and lower post, a turned section with collars and a four-start rope twist cut into the turned surface, a sill with V-notched ends, six forged nail heads (M_TW_Metal). 2.4 m tall assumed.

name: Sun-disc weather vane
Wetterfahne mit Sonnenscheibe
pieces.note: Cast brass: turned column (vase finial, trumpet, collars, stepped base) measured row by row; flame finial and the flag (tail fleur, pierced quatrefoil sun with rays, flame tendrils) traced and cast as one relief, thin parts round, plates 7 mm with rounded edges; the sun's two raised rings on both faces. 1 px = 1 mm.

name: Grid-banner weather vane
Wetterfahne mit Gitterbanner
pieces.note: Cast brass: turned column with orb, collars and base; fleur finial, beaded grid banner with fleur corners and the ringed fleurs on the crossbar traced and cast as relief; raised square frames round the six quatrefoil windows; turned crossbar arms; the orb's leaf crown modelled (four splayed legs, a ring, eight lobed leaves). 1 px = 1 mm.

name: Orb weather finial with fleury cross
Wetterspitze mit Kugel und Lilienkreuz
pieces.note: Cast brass: turned column (trumpet neck, orb, carved collar, rod, stepped base) measured row by row; the orb a true sphere with three raised straps and 16 rivets; the pierced fleury cross traced and cast as relief. The collar's carving is texture. 1 px = 1 mm.

name: Wooden urn baluster
Holzbaluster mit Urne
pieces.note: Turned (build_lathe.py, widths measured to a fraction of a pixel every 1 px): ring collars, a long tapering body over a turned urn, square blocks top and bottom. 85 cm tall assumed.

name: Sawn scroll baluster
Gesägter Baluster mit Ranken
pieces.note: Mixed: turned collars top and bottom; the middle a sawn board 4 cm thick with heart-and-scroll openings, its narrow bars rounded like carving (traced, cast as relief). 85 cm tall assumed.

name: Slender wooden baluster
Schlanker Holzbaluster
pieces.note: Turned: fine rings, a long slender shaft swelling below the middle, a small vase and rings at the foot; square blocks. 85 cm tall assumed.

name: Wooden pear baluster
Holzbaluster mit Birnform
pieces.note: Turned: ring collars, a long pear-shaped body over a ball, square blocks. 85 cm tall assumed.
